revised_comments: Burkina Faso's national utility, SONABEL, applies an increasing block tariff for residential customers: the social band charges around XOF 75 (approximately USD 0.13) per kWh for the first 50 kWh consumed each month, rising to roughly XOF 128-138 per kWh for higher consumption bands. Average quoted residential electricity prices sit around USD 0.18-0.22 per kWh. Gross national income per capita (Atlas method) is USD 840-850 (2023-2024), among the lowest in the region, so even a modest monthly electricity bill represents a substantial share of household income, placing affordability toward the expensive end of the scale on international benchmarks.
